The untrusted input argv[1] is only compared against the literals "up" and "down" at lines 56 and 60, and any value not matching these literals results in no change to brightness. Therefore there is no path from the untrusted source to an OS command execution. Also the file path is hard‑coded, so even if brightness were somehow tainted, it would not be used in a command context. Hence the reported OS command injection is not possible.
